title: Shopping List Before Sales
pin_title: ADHD Black Friday Tips: Write the Shopping List Before You Browse
description: Sales are designed to hijack attention. With ADHD, a list written before browsing is your best protection. Write only what you already planned to buy, set a total amount, and close the tab when the list is done. A wanted item is fine; an item you only wanted because of a timer can wait. #ADHD #BlackFriday #MindfulSpending #ADHDBudget

title: The 24 Hour Pause
pin_title: ADHD Impulse Spending Pause: The 24-Hour Rule That Actually Helps
description: Impulse buys feel urgent because dopamine is asking for a quick win. Try a 24-hour pause: put the item in a cart or a note, set a reminder, and decide tomorrow. Most urges fade by morning. If you still want it, you can buy it with a clear head and no guilt. #ADHD #ImpulseSpending #ADHDBudget #DopamineTips

title: Gifts: One Budget Per Person

description: Gift shopping gets easier when each name has a number next to it. List the people, write a budget for each one, then add one idea per person.
